title: A Portrait for the Inheritance
author: Ulyana Brightwater
blurb: Ines Hartwell, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
